easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Ardent Electromancer with haste.
When Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ardent Electromancer token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Ardent Electromancer token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.
